name: OpenClaw
description:
OpenClaw is a modern, open-source reimplementation of Captain Claw (1997), the beloved 2D pirate side-scrolling platformer created by Monolith Productions. It reconstructs the game engine in C++ and SDL2.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit operating systems with high framerates
- Widescreen and high-resolution display rendering with scalable HUD elements
- Full support for modern gamepads, joysticks, and configurable keyboard controls
- Faithfully reproduces all original levels, animated cutscenes, and swordplay
- Requires original Captain Claw game data files to run
